name: scicp
description: A high-performance, web-based scripture projection engine.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend  && npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.check:prod: npm run build && npm run test:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build --workspace=frontend && cd electron && npm install && npx electron ..
scripts.build-fts: echo 'FTS tables are pre-built in all DBs — no build step needed'
scripts.build-fts:force: echo 'FTS tables are pre-built in all DBs — no build step needed'
scripts.mobile:android: cd mobile && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:ios: cd mobile && npm run build && npx cap sync ios
